constraints: Clean room investigation of public client-side web bundle, static assets, and mockable API structure
params.done_when: The app interface, routes (/daftar, /masuk, /dashboard, etc.), CSS, assets, and state handling are reconstructed and integrated.
params.purpose: Recreate the app.apiqris.com merchant dashboard & authentication portal and integrate it into the repository.
params.question: How is https://app.apiqris.com built and structured, and how can its dashboard, register (/daftar), and login (/masuk) web application be recreated faithfully?

steps.title: Analyze app.apiqris.com web application bundles and routing
steps.why: Inspect client-side router, assets, CSS, API calls, and authentication flows.

steps.title: Extract and recreate app assets, styles, and SPA entrypoint
steps.why: Prepare app bundle and static assets (CSS, JS, icons) for hosting.

steps.title: Integrate /daftar, /masuk, and app routes into the repository
steps.why: Allow buttons from landing page to link directly to working local/hosted app views.

steps.title: Deploy and test end-to-end routing on GitHub Pages
steps.why: Ensure clicking Daftar Gratis or Masuk seamlessly opens the registration/login interface.

params.claim: app.apiqris.com is a standalone React 18 Single Page Application (Vite bundle) containing registration (/daftar), login (/masuk), and full merchant portal routes.
params.prediction: The SPA bundle assets (JS, CSS, static media) can be hosted and integrated under /app/ or /daftar/ so visitors can access the merchant portal.

params.statement: app.apiqris.com is a React SPA built with Vite and TailwindCSS using client-side React Router for paths including /daftar, /masuk, /qris, /mutasi, and communicates with backend API endpoints under /api/*.

params.note: Verified bundle structure and routes extracted from compiled bundle.

steps.title: Analyze app.apiqris.com web application bundles and routing
steps.why: Extracted router definitions, authentication state, and backend API endpoints.

steps.title: Extract and recreate app assets, styles, and SPA entrypoint
steps.why: Downloaded all app JavaScript chunks, stylesheets, and icons to /app/.

steps.title: Integrate /daftar, /masuk, and app routes into the repository
steps.why: Patched client-side router basename and API base URL; created static entrypoints for /app/daftar/ and /app/masuk/.

steps.title: Deploy and test end-to-end routing on GitHub Pages
steps.why: Updated landing page CTA buttons to link directly to internal app routes.

params.text: Both apiqris.com and app.apiqris.com have been investigated, extracted, and integrated into this repository. The React SPA (app.apiqris.com) is installed in /app/ with entrypoints for /app/daftar/ and /app/masuk/. All CTA buttons across the landing pages have been updated from external app.apiqris.com links to internal /apiqris/app/daftar/ and /apiqris/app/masuk/ routes. Router basename and API endpoints are configurable.
